senses.gloss: m. (denom. of שְׁכֶם) shikhmi, by-name of a certain class of Pharisees.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:5:7">Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>פרוש ש׳</he>, expl. <he>טעין מצוותא וכ׳</he> who carries religious exercises on his shoulder; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 5:5:4">Y. Sot. V, 20ᶜ</cite> bot.; Bab.
<cite ref="Sotah 22b:3">Sot. 22ᵇ</cite>, expl. <he>זה העושה מעשה שכם</he> he who acts like Shechem (who underwent circumcision from an unholy motive).
